plugin_description: Native browser voice laboratory for WordPress utilizing Web Audio API & Web Speech API.
mode_recorder_desc: Record your voice, listen to it in the player, and download as clean .wav audio.
mode_recognition_desc: Read the target sentence out loud. The system analyzes your speech and scores accuracy.
score_good: Very good! Minor subtleties to polish.
score_fair: Good effort! Keep practicing to refine accent.
score_retry: Please try again clearly, speaking close to the microphone.
mic_permission_denied: Microphone access was denied or unavailable.
speech_not_supported: Speech recognition is not supported in this browser. Chrome or Edge is recommended.
